slots.node01.text: Most of the savings come from work that stops, not work that speeds up.
slots.node04.text: Manual intercompany matching, duplicate review and rework after sign-off account for most of the $4.2M run-rate saving. None of it needs a faster tool; it needs the work designed out of the process.
slots.node05.text: We size the saving from the close calendar for 14 business units, then validate each line with the entity controller before it enters the business case.
slots.title: Where the savings come from
